name: inspect_root
title: Inspect a Waterloo root
description: Get a compact structural overview of one Waterloo root before drilling into objects or searches.

arguments.name: root_id
arguments.description: The root identifier returned by list_roots.

messages.content:
Inspect the Waterloo root $root_id.

Start with `get_root_metadata` to get the compact overview.
Then use `list_objects` to see the available objects.
If the root is large, also use `search_objects`, `search_sections`, and `search_text`
before drilling into individual objects.

Return a short, structured summary with:
- scope and kind
- the main entry points for further inspection
- notable search hits or object clusters
- the next object(s) to inspect first
